full_name: Trysh Travis | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 History Evelyn Green Davis Fellow University of Florida
bio: Trysh Travis is a historian of drugs and alcohol and their intersections with popular mental health cultures. At Radcliffe, she will work on the book “Feminists on Drugs: A History,” which traces the development of substance abuse treatment for women from the grassroots into the mainstream during the last decades of the 20th century.
